description: Geocode a free-form US address into coordinates and structured components (street_address, city, county, state, postal_code) plus a formatted address and place_id — exactly the identity fields create_listing requires. Use this first, then pass the result straight into create_listing instead of supplying your own coordinates.

address.description: Free-form address to geocode, e.g. "3763 Imperial St, Frederick, CO 80516".
